title: Spark Evidence Lab: rerunnable experiment cards with honest verdicts
description:
Spark Evidence Lab is a static browser lab that presents experiments from the author's open research repositories as cards: the claim tested, the conditions, the difference against a simple baseline with its uncertainty, a status (Reproduced / Baseline stronger / Open question / Exploratory), links to the source code at an exact commit, and the commands to rerun it. Failed and negative results are included. Every number is copied from a committed file in the source repository.

A JavaScript port of the OES-32 residual is checked bit-exact against contract vectors generated from the Python reference in oes32-residual.

Scope: research software. Synthetic data is labelled synthetic; one card is simulator-only and one is a classical toy simulation. Nothing here claims quantum error correction, a threshold, quantum advantage, hardware performance or consciousness.

No runtime dependencies, no build step, no backend. Node tests and a link check run in GitHub Actions. License: AGPL-3.0-only.
